cases.situation: I've emailed a local bookstore owner, Ruth, twice about hosting a reading of my novel. No reply in 3 weeks. Want to send one last email.
cases.reply: Hi Ruth, last nudge from me on the reading. I'll assume the timing isn't right and stop filling your inbox, but if a slot opens up in the new year, I'd still love to do it at Chapter House. Thanks, Nadia
cases.note: Third and final bump: close the loop yourself, and don't send a fourth.

cases.situation: 周六组织同学聚餐，今天必须跟饭店订包间，老王还没回我来不来。
cases.reply: 老王，周六的包间我今晚8点前要跟饭店确认，你来不来？来不来都行，回个字就好。
cases.note: 把回复变得很小，截止时间是为了订位，不是为了催人。

cases.situation: I followed up with my contractor about the kitchen quote and he snapped back 'I saw it, I've been slammed.' I still need it before I can book anyone.
cases.reply: Totally understand. No rush from me before the 20th; after that I'll need to start lining someone up, so a rough date for the quote would help whenever you get a sec.
cases.note: Don't defend the nudge. Take the answer, give room, and state the real planning date once.

cases.situation: My former professor, Dr. Hayes, agreed on Sept 8 to write me a recommendation for a master's program. The deadline is Oct 15 and the portal still shows it as not submitted. I already resent the link once on Sept 15.
cases.reply:
Hi Dr. Hayes,
I know the start of term is hectic. A quick note on the recommendation for the Urban Planning MA at Northfield: the portal still shows it as pending, and the deadline is Thursday 15 October. I've pasted the upload link below so you don't have to dig for it. If a short list of the projects I did in your seminar would save you time, I can send it today.
Thank you again,
Sofia
cases.note: Assume busy, restate the thing and the date in one line, and make doing it easier than postponing it. Don't ask whether they're still willing.

cases.situation: 10天前微信问大学室友小敏愿不愿意明年5月当我伴娘，她显示已读但一直没回。她最近刚换工作。我有点慌，怕她不想又不好意思拒绝。
cases.reply: 小敏，知道你刚换工作肯定忙翻了。上次问你明年5月当伴娘的事，你别有压力，愿意、不方便、还要再想想，哪个答案都完全没问题。11月15日前告诉我一声就行，我好安排礼服。
cases.note: 给她一个体面说“不”的出口，截止时间说成是为了安排礼服，不是催她。

cases.situation: Uni group project, presentation is Thursday at 10am. I asked Ellie in the group chat on Friday and again Sunday for her 4 slides on the survey results. She's read both, no reply. We're putting the deck together tomorrow night.
cases.reply: Hey Ellie, I know it's a heavy week. Are your 4 survey slides on track? We're merging the deck tomorrow at 7pm. If it's easier, send whatever you have, even rough numbers, and Tom and I will do the formatting.
cases.note: Move from the group chat to a direct message, make the reply tiny, and take work off her plate. If nothing by tomorrow noon, split her slides between you and stop chasing.

cases.situation: My friend Chloe moved to Berlin in June. I've texted her twice since August and she hasn't answered. I don't need anything from her, I just miss her and don't want to sound hurt.
cases.reply: Hey Chloe, no agenda, just thinking of you and wondering how Berlin's treating you. No need for a proper reply, a photo of your street or your favourite bakery would make my week.
cases.note: With a friend, drop the old thread entirely; the follow-up is about her, with a reply so small it costs nothing.

cases.situation: Ich bin am 31. Juli aus meiner Wohnung in Leipzig ausgezogen, die Übergabe war ohne Mängel. Am 1. September habe ich die Hausverwaltung, Frau Krüger, per Mail nach meiner Kaution von 1.650 Euro gefragt und nie eine Antwort bekommen. Ich will nachhaken, ohne unfreundlich zu wirken.
cases.reply:
Sehr geehrte Frau Krüger,
ich weiß, dass bei Ihnen gerade viel los ist, und melde mich noch einmal wegen meiner Mietkaution für die Wohnung Kochstraße 14, 2. OG links. Die Übergabe war am 31. Juli ohne Mängel, die Kaution beträgt 1.650 Euro. Könnten Sie mir kurz sagen, bis wann ich mit der Rückzahlung rechnen kann? Ein ungefähres Datum reicht mir völlig, damit ich planen kann. Meine IBAN steht in der Mail vom 1. September, ich schicke sie aber gern noch einmal.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Tobias Lange
cases.note: Zweiter Anstoß: das Anliegen in einer Zeile und eine winzige Antwort (ein Datum). Ein Teil darf bis zur Nebenkostenabrechnung einbehalten werden, deshalb nach einem Datum fragen statt sofortige Zahlung fordern.

cases.situation: 我在做季度经营分析，一周前在钉钉上找财务部的小陈要三季度各区域的退款数据，三天前又提醒过一次，都没回。报告10月12日周一要交。
cases.reply: 小陈，知道季度末你们财务最忙。还是三季度各区域退款数据的事，我的报告10月12日要交，如果明天下班前能给我就能赶上；来不及的话，给我一个大概时间也行，我好排进度。实在排不开也没关系，告诉我找谁拿更方便。
cases.note: 第二次提醒：先替对方想到忙，一句话说清要什么，截止时间是为了排期，再留一个体面的出口。

cases.situation: Two weeks ago I messaged Rachel, a former colleague who's now at Stripe, asking for a 20-minute chat about their data team. She said 'sure, ping me next week', I did last Tuesday, and nothing since. She's doing me a favour so I don't want to be a pest.
cases.reply: Hi Rachel, I know things get hectic, so one more try on the chat about the data team. Would 20 minutes on Thursday Oct 8 or Friday Oct 9 work, any time after 11? If the next few weeks are packed, a quick 'not now' is completely fine and I'll leave it there.
cases.note: Second bump to someone doing you a favour: two concrete slots and an easy out, because she owes you nothing.

cases.situation: I'm a garden designer. I sent a £4,200 quote to a couple, Helen and James Patterson, on Sept 17 after a site visit, and bumped it once on the 24th. Nothing since, and I'm booking my November slots this week.
cases.reply:
Hi Helen and James,
I know autumn gets busy, so just a quick one on the garden quote from 17 September. I'm filling my November slots this week and would be glad to hold one for you. If the timing or budget isn't right, a one-line 'not now' is genuinely helpful, and I'm happy to rework the scope, for example the patio this year and the planting in spring.
Best,
Owen
cases.note: Second bump from the seller's side: a real reason, a smaller option and an easy no. If this gets nothing, send one closing note and stop.

cases.situation: I had a final-round interview for a marketing manager role at Halden Foods on Friday Sept 18. The recruiter, Chris, said they'd decide by the end of last week, and I've heard nothing. I also have another offer I need to answer by Monday Oct 5.
cases.reply:
Hi Chris,
I know hiring decisions often take longer than planned. I'm following up on the marketing manager role after my final interview on 18 September. I'm still very keen, and I have another offer I need to answer by Monday 5 October, so any update on your timeline before then would help me plan. Even a rough date is useful.
Thanks,
Jordan Lee
cases.note: A competing deadline is a real reason to nudge: say it once, plainly, as planning information rather than an ultimatum.

cases.situation: 7月初朋友阿杰找我借了3000块周转，说8月底还。8月底我提过一次，他说“下周”，之后就没下文了。我10月10号要交房租，不想伤感情。
cases.reply: 阿杰，知道你最近换工作事情多。还是7月那3000块的事，我10月10号要交房租，想问下你大概哪天方便转我？一次还不上也没关系，先转一部分、剩下的定个日子也行，给我个准话就好。
cases.note: 借钱的跟进只要一个日期：截止时间说成是自己要交房租，给分期的台阶，不翻“你说过下周”的旧账。

cases.situation: In my review on Sept 3, my manager Karen said she'd put me forward for the senior analyst promotion and get back to me 'in a couple of weeks'. It's been four weeks and I mentioned it once in passing on the 17th. I don't want to seem pushy with my own boss. Slack DM.
cases.reply: Hi Karen, I know quarter-end is busy. A quick one on the senior analyst promotion we talked about in my review on 3 September: is there an update, or a rough date when you expect to hear? Even 'still in progress' is useful. If it would help, I can put together a one-page summary of my Q3 pricing work by Friday.
cases.note: With your own manager, ask about timing rather than commitment, and offer something that makes her case easier to push through.

cases.situation: The heating in my flat stopped working on Sept 21. I texted my landlord, Mr. Doyle, that day and he said he'd send someone 'this week'. Nobody came, I nudged on Sept 26 and got no reply. Nights are dropping to about 4°C.
cases.reply: Hi Mr. Doyle, I know you've got a lot on. Following up on the heating at 12 Carlow Road, which has been off since 21 September; nights are getting close to freezing now. Could you let me know which day your engineer can come? I'm home all day Friday and Monday, or I can leave a key with the neighbour at number 14.
cases.note: Second bump: the date it started, a one-word reply (a day), and access made easy. Keep the texts; if this gets nothing, check your lease and local tenant advice on repairs.

cases.situation: 我是自由摄影师，8月给一个咖啡品牌拍了新品图，8月10日开了8,000元的发票，合同写收到发票后30天内付款。9月15日问过市场部对接人周小姐，她说“在走流程”，之后就没消息了。
cases.reply: 周小姐您好，知道节前大家都忙。跟进一下8月新品拍摄的8,000元款项：发票是8月10日开的，按合同是30天内付款，现在已经过了约定时间。麻烦帮我确认一下大概哪天能付？如果需要我补什么材料，告诉我就行。
cases.note: State the contract term once, as a fact; the only thing you ask for is a payment date.

cases.situation: 我是儿子班上的家委会成员。9月23日在家长群发了放学护导的接龙：10月9日起每周五下午3:30到4:00在校门口，一共要排12位家长，到现在只有2位接了。排班表得在10月7日前交给班主任。
cases.reply: 各位家长好，知道这阵子大家都忙，国庆前再提一下护导接龙。10月9日起每周五下午3:30到4:00，在校门口站半小时就行。方便的直接在接龙里填名字和想排的日期；这学期排不开的，私信我一句“不行”也很有帮助。我10月7日前要把排班表交给班主任，谢谢大家！
cases.note: 群里跟进不点名、不数谁没接，给“不行”留个出口，比催促更能让人动。
